pack.title: Pushy salespeople
pack.description: End an unwanted pitch and keep moving.

scenarios.setting: A street salesperson continues after you decline.
scenarios.jab: Wait, you haven't even heard the offer!
scenarios.goal: End an unwanted pitch and keep moving.

replies.line: I'm not interested. Have a good day.
replies.why: It declines the interaction without offering a reason to overcome.
replies.delivery: Keep walking if appropriate; use a clear voice and do not stop to defend the refusal.

replies.why: It states your decision and exit in a short sentence.
replies.delivery: Keep walking if appropriate; use a clear voice and do not stop to defend the refusal.

replies.line: Thanks, but I don't want to hear the offer today.
replies.why: It remains courteous while clearly declining more conversation.
replies.delivery: Keep walking if appropriate; use a clear voice and do not stop to defend the refusal.

replies.line: My shopping department is closed today.
replies.why: A small joke expresses your decision without judging the product.
replies.delivery: Keep walking if appropriate; use a clear voice and do not stop to defend the refusal.

followUp.why: It repeats the refusal without accepting the salesperson's time framing.
followUp.delivery: Keep walking if appropriate; use a clear voice and do not stop to defend the refusal.
